q: for in them God’s wrath is finished

s: temple of the tabernacle of the testimony is inaccessible until seven last plagues finished (no one able to enter)
q: No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

s: seven angels wears pure, bright linen (clothing)
q: clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests

s: seven angels wears golden sashes (around their chests)
q: clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests

s: seven angels has golden bowls (seven bowls given by a living creature)
q: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God

s: golden bowls contains wrath of God
q: seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God

s: God lives forever and ever
q: the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever

s: overcomers (those who overcame the beast) stands on sea of glass
q: those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass

s: overcomers (those who overcame the beast) has harps of God
q: having harps of God

s: seven angels possess seven bowls of the wrath of God (each pours out a bowl)
q: “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

s: beast has throne of the beast
q: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened.

s: beast has kingdom (darkened after the fifth bowl)
q: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened.

s: Harmagedon is a place (called so in Hebrew; where the kings are gathered)
q: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.

s: Babylon the great was divided into three parts (the great city; cities of the nations fell)
q: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God

s: Babylon the great receives cup of the wine of the fierceness of God's wrath (remembered before God to be given it)
q: Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

s: great earthquake has attribute unprecedented in magnitude (greatest since men were on earth)
q: a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.
